meta.source: Legal Metrology Act, 2009 + Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended)
meta.disclaimer: Sub-rule numbers are indicative and based on the consolidated/amended text as commonly cited. Before final submission, have one team member cross-check each rule_ref against the latest official gazette notification, since several sub-rules were renumbered by amendments in 2017 and 2022.
notes: Fields marked applicability != 'all' only apply to specific package/commodity categories.
font_size_table values are in millimetres and represent MINIMUM required numeral/letter height.
This file is the single source of truth for compliance logic — do not hardcode any rule thresholds in Python code.

principal_display_panel.description: All mandatory declarations must appear together on the Principal Display Panel (PDP), except where a rule explicitly allows an exception.

area_calculation.rectangular_package: height_mm * width_mm of one full side

small_package_exception.allowance: Declarations may be on a card or tape firmly affixed to the package instead of printed directly.

declarations.display_name: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer/Packer/Importer
declarations.notes: No strict regex — validate primarily via presence + minimum text length + proximity to address-like tokens (PIN code pattern, city name). Full NER/keyword scoring recommended over pure regex.
Usually the largest/most prominent text on the front panel (brand + product type). Cross-check against a known product-category keyword list if available.

declarations.display_name: Net Quantity (weight / volume / number / length / area)
declarations.rule_ref: Rule 6(1)(c) read with Rule 8(2) Table-I / Table-II
declarations.letter_width_rule: Width of letter/numeral shall not be less than 1/3 of its height (except numeral '1' and letters i/I/l).

surrounding_space_rule.above_below_mm: at least equal to numeral height
surrounding_space_rule.left_right_mm: at least twice the numeral height
surrounding_space_rule.description: Area immediately surrounding the net quantity declaration must be free of any other printed text/graphics.

declarations.notes: This is the highest-scrutiny field — implement font_measure.py against this exact tiered table, not a flat threshold.

declarations.display_name: Maximum Retail Price (inclusive of all taxes)

font_size_table.basis: Same Table-I tiers as net_quantity, applied independently to the MRP numeral height

declarations.notes: Two separate checks: (1) currency+amount format regex match, (2) presence of the mandatory tax-inclusivity phrase. Both must pass.

font_size_table.description: Unit sale price numeral height must be at least 50% of the MRP numeral height on the same package.

declarations.notes: Only mark mandatory=true dynamically at runtime if the product is detected as a multi-piece/wholesale package.

declarations.display_name: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing / Import
declarations.notes: Applicability changed by amendment (omitted for food articles from 01.10.2022) — check rules_config against product category before flagging as missing.
Only mandatory=true at runtime if commodity_category flags perishability (e.g. food, pharma, cosmetics with shelf life).
Must contain at least a phone number OR an email; toll-free numbers are common — regex should match both landline and toll-free formats.

declarations.rule_ref: Rule 6(1)(k) / Legal Metrology (PC) (Amendment) provisions for imported goods
declarations.notes: Set mandatory=true dynamically only when the product is flagged/detected as an imported item.

font_size_table.basis: Table-II (declared in length, area or number)
font_size_table.note: Populate Table-II tiers here once sourced from the official gazette; structurally identical to Table-I.

declarations.notes: Lower priority field — implement after the eight fields above are working end-to-end.

prohibited_declarations.description: If any of these vague/ambiguous terms appear near a net-quantity declaration, flag as a violation even if a valid numeral is also present.

severity_levels.description: Use this to rank violations in the report — CRITICAL fields missing should drive the overall_compliance_status to NON_COMPLIANT with highest-priority flagging; MINOR fields may only trigger a warning rather than outright rejection, at the team's discretion.
